messages:
Lena (Marketing): Quick sync - we need a compact battlecard refresh for the upcoming benchmark release + webinar. Key asks: 1) 3 headline plays vs Cloud AI, LLM APIs, infra vendors; 2) SDR one-pager; 3) inbound routing suggestions for leads calling out 'cost' or 'latency'. Anyone free for a 20m brain-dump?

Ravi (Product Marketing): I am. My vote: frame around 'predictable unit economics' + 'deployment parity' + 'operational resilience'. Those map cleanly to Cost / Migration / Reliability objections.

Nora (Growth): Agreed. Also propose a small A/B test for the PR headline: A) 'Cut inference spend without code changes' vs B) 'Keep SLAs while cutting model costs'. We'll see which drives demo signups.

Sam (Sales): For SDRs, prioritize short rebut scripts + migration path. Most customers say "we're on CloudX and invested". Need a 30s pitch + pilot hook.

Lena (Marketing): Drafting three headline plays now: 
- Cost play (clouds): 'Inference-aware routing cuts per-token spend while preserving latency'
- API play (LLM APIs): 'Same API, better economics: route transparently across variants and regions'
- Infra play (self-hosted runtimes): 'Production runtime + observability out-of-the-box 10% ops time saved vs bespoke'
Feedback?

Ravi (Product Marketing): Swap last percent to a qualitative line: 'boots-on-the-ground telemetry for real regressions' - quantitative ops claims are messy unless we can cite a customer.

Sam (Sales): For SDR script, something like: 
```
Subject: 30m pilot to cut inference cost
Hi {{first_name}},
Quick note 1) we benchmarked RAG workloads and saw ~28% lower per-token cost with routing + dedicated pools; 2) we offer a 30m pilot and migration plan. Interested?
```
Keep it skimmable.

Nora (Growth): Love the template. We'll test 2 variants: one with the percent and one with a qualitative claim. Track opens => demos.

bench-bot: Benchmark deck uploaded: https://drive.redwood/bench/launch_v2.pdf (includes RAG/chat/seq workloads).

Lena (Marketing): Battlecard front bullets (draft): 
- Claim: 'Cut real-world inference spend 20-35% vs baseline managed endpoints'
- How: 'Smart routing, KV/prefix caching, and workload-aware batching'
- Proof: 'Bench: RAG 28% cost delta; p95 latency 220ms vs 320ms'
- Close: 'Pilot offers migration support + usage credit'

Ravi (Product Marketing): Add a one-liner under 'How' about fallback variants: 'Automatic fallback to compatible quantized/cheap variants on congestion keeps SLAs intact.'

Sam (Sales): Add an objection card for 'we already use VendorY's managed endpoint' - short script: 
"VendorY is great for easy ops. If unit costs or region/fallbacks matter, our pilot shows delta in <2 weeks."

Nora (Growth): For inbound routing rules: if lead message contains 'cost' OR 'spend' -> route to Growth (pilot), tag with 'econ-claim'. If 'latency' or 'p95' -> route to Solutions (low-latency demo). If 'private' or 'on-prem' -> AE enterprise. Also add an automated reply template — "Thanks! We'll route you to the right team; would you share workload type?"

Lena (Marketing): Nice. Can someone mock the SDR one-pager (single page) tonight? I can then export to PDF for reps.

Sam (Sales): I'll draft the one-pager. Will include: top-line claim, 3 bullets of proof, 3 SDR rebut lines, 2-step pilot CTA.

Ravi (Product Marketing): Also let's include a small competitor claim matrix on the back: CloudX | LLM API vendors | Infra vendors with ticks for 'routing', 'dedicated pools', 'private deploy', 'observable econ'. Keep it single-column per competitor.

Nora (Growth): For the webinar, plan a 10-min demo showing: baseline endpoint -> Redwood routing -> fallback to quantized variant under spike. Then a 5-min Q&A + 3 slide 'how to pilot' close.

bench-bot: Playbook template uploaded: https://drive.redwood/templates/inbound-routing-playbook.md

Lena (Marketing): Timeline: 
- Today: SDR one-pager draft (Sam) + battlecard bullets (this thread)
- Tomorrow: PR headline A/B assets + landing copy (Nora)
- Fri: Rehearsal + publish webinar invite

Sam (Sales): Will post the one-pager draft here by 18:00 PST.

Ravi (Product Marketing): Quick note - ensure legal signs off on any % claims. I'll coordinate.

Lena (Marketing): Good call. I'll hold off publishing the PR until legal okays the bench calls. Thanks all :) :rocket:
